verdict.rationale: The DGX B300 exposes a programmatic management interface through its BMC (Redfish/IPMI), so asking whether a machine-readable API spec is available is a fair question for this product. The evidence never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for that interface, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt files are documentation indexes, not API specs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
